name: Jump
subcategory: AI meeting assistant for financial advisors
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records advisor client meetings, writes compliant notes, and pushes tasks and summaries into the CRM.

pricing.notes: AI-drafted from a site submission; price unverified.

verdictSummary: The transcribe-and-summarize core is now a solved commodity: local Whisper plus a decent model will give you clean meeting notes with a custom template in an afternoon. What you cannot one-shot is the boring half of this product, which is the part advisors actually buy: a bot that reliably joins Zoom and Teams calls, structured write-back into Redtail, Wealthbox or Salesforce, and notes shaped to survive a compliance review. If you are a solo operator who just wants notes and a task list out of your own recordings, build it. If you are a regulated advisor whose firm needs an audit trail and CRM hygiene, the DIY version is a toy that creates work instead of removing it.
coreLoopDIY: Records or ingests a meeting audio file, transcribes it locally, and generates a structured client note plus follow-up tasks against a template you control, stored in a local SQLite database with full-text search.
requirements: ffmpeg and a virtual audio device for capturing call audio (BlackHole on macOS, loopback on Windows)
Local Whisper model or an API key for transcription
An LLM API key in .env for summarization
Comfort running a local Python service and a browser UI
whatYouLose: A meeting bot that auto-joins Zoom, Teams and Google Meet without you babysitting the recorder
Two-way CRM sync, so every note and task is copy-paste by hand
Compliance posture: retention policy, audit trail, supervision review, and the vendor paperwork your firm asks for
Advisor-specific prompt tuning built from a lot of real advisor meetings, which is why their notes read like advisor notes
Mobile capture, calendar awareness, and anything resembling support when a recording fails mid-meeting
moatNotes: The CRM write-back and the regulated-industry comfort blanket are the product; the transcription is table stakes everyone has.
whyPeopleStillPay: Advisors are not paying for summaries, they are paying to never touch the CRM again and to have a defensible record if a regulator asks what was discussed. Those are integration and compliance problems, not AI problems, and both get worse the more clients you have. A personal build also puts the recording failure mode on you, which is a bad trade when the artifact is a client conversation you cannot re-run.
notes: The notes are easy, the CRM round-trip and the compliance paper trail are not; build it for yourself, not for a firm.
prompt:
Build a local meeting notes tool for client conversations. No accounts, no cloud storage, no telemetry.

Stack, non-negotiable:
- Python 3.11, FastAPI, Jinja2 templates with HTMX for interactions, plain CSS, no frontend framework
- SQLite via sqlite3 with an FTS5 virtual table for transcript and note search
- faster-whisper for local transcription, default model "small.en", configurable in .env
- ffmpeg shelled out for audio normalization and chunking
- An OpenAI-compatible chat completions call for summarization, base URL and key from .env

Features, in scope:
- Upload page accepting .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .mp4; store the file under ./data/audio/
- Background job (threading or a simple in-process queue, no Celery) that transcribes with word-level timestamps and writes segments to SQLite
- Note templates stored as editable markdown prompt files in ./templates_prompts/, ship two: "client_meeting" (attendees, context, decisions, open questions, action items with owners) and "raw_summary"
- After transcription, generate a note from the chosen template and save it as a revision; keep every revision, never overwrite
- Meeting detail page: transcript with timestamps, note side by side, editable note body, checkbox task list extracted from the note
- Search page over transcripts and notes using FTS5, with snippet highlighting
- "Export" button producing a single markdown file per meeting plus a JSON dump of all meetings for backup

Out of scope, do not build:
- No meeting bot, no Zoom/Teams/Meet joining, no calendar integration
- No CRM integration of any kind
- No multi-user auth, no sharing, no hosted deployment

Requirements:
- Secrets only in .env, read via python-dotenv, ship .env.example
- Everything runs with: uv sync (or pip install -r requirements.txt) then uvicorn app:app
- README documents how to capture system audio on macOS with BlackHole and on Windows with a loopback device, and states plainly that this records conversations and that consent and retention are the operator's problem
- Seed script that ingests a sample wav so the UI is not empty on first run
